senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; פָּתַח Pi.) incision, engraving, engraved design.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:3:5">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ</cite> <he>פ׳ ידים ורגלים וכ׳</he> it (the embryo) has no incisions indicating the outlines of hands and of feet.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:9:2">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הומר היא בפ׳</he> the law is stricter in the case of an engraving made on a tree (Asherah).—Pl. <he>פִּיתּוּחִים</he>, <he>פִּיתּוּחִין</he>, <cite ref="Q00890"><he>פִּתּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:9:2">Ib.</cite> <he>העכיר את הפ׳</he> if he effaced the engraving. Ohol. XIV, 1 <he>העטרות והפ׳</he> the wreaths and engravings (mouldings above the entrance); Tosef. ib. XIV, 10 <he>הפִּתּוּיִין</he>.
